intro: Where the theme has got to, drawn from this guide's roadmap file: the stops reached, the one under way, the route planned next, and what waits on no stop yet.

milestones.name: port
milestones.title: The Tabler port
items: Tabler's tokens, cards, tables and navbar, hand-written with no build step.
The reader's settings: light or dark, the base gray, the accent, the corners and the font.

milestones.name: pages
milestones.title: Pages from data
items: The [lexicon](lexicon.md), its tooltips and its page.
Each page's [standing](components/standing.md), from its front matter or a status file.

milestones.name: markdown
milestones.title: Markdown's extensions
items: Admonitions as Tabler's alerts, tabs as its card tabs, maths by KaTeX.
[Reference pages](components/reference.md), a card for each object.

milestones.name: kit
milestones.title: The kit
items: The stylesheets and scripts as a kit for [pages written by hand](kit.md), copied into a project by `scripts/export-ui.sh`.
Portal's [dashboard](components/dashboard.md) pieces: canvas charts, KPI cards, the period control, card tabs, the tracking strip and a table filter.
The [grid and utilities](components/grid.md), and [buttons, forms, dialogs, toasts, menus and pagination](components/forms.md).

milestones.name: roadmap
milestones.title: The roadmap
items: This page: stops on Tabler's timeline, the route as numbered steps.

milestones.name: first-site
milestones.title: The first site
items: A project's own site moved over from Material for MkDocs.

milestones.name: release
milestones.title: The first release
items: A licence, and the package published.

planned.lead: The roadmap, then the first site, in the order they land.
steps: The page drawn from its file, with `roadmap: true`.
The first site's switch-over, its stylesheets ported to the theme's tokens.

pending.lead: In no particular order, and on no stop yet.

groups.title: Components
items: Tabler's remaining pieces, as projects ask for them: card footers and status, accordions, select groups, spinners and placeholders, breadcrumbs.
A changelog page drawn from its file.

groups.title: Tooling
items: A check that every page's links resolve.
